blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala set a new career-high ranking of World No. 17 ahead of her campaign in the Hong Kong Open. Eala’s previous best was 18th last August 24 just before the US Open. She entered the 2026 season at No. 50. The 21-year-old Eala is aiming to finish her breakthrough season on a high note in Hong Kong, which is the last stop of her Asian swing.
